pins.name: Diamond Head State Monument (Leahi summit trail)
pins.blurb: The crater-rim climb over Waikiki. Go at 6 a.m.

pins.name: Pipiwai Trail to Waimoku Falls (Kipahulu District)
pins.blurb: Maui's best jungle hike: a banyan, a bamboo forest and a 400-foot waterfall.

pins.name: Iao Valley State Monument
pins.blurb: A short loop into a lush valley under the Iao Needle.

pins.name: Manoa Falls Trail
pins.blurb: The closest real rainforest to Waikiki. Muddy, rooty and busy.

pins.name: Kualoa Ranch Jungle Expedition
pins.blurb: An open-air ride into a rainforest valley and its film sites.

pins.name: Akaka Falls State Park
pins.blurb: A 442-foot waterfall on a short rainforest loop above Hilo.

pins.name: Rainbow Falls (Wailuku River State Park)
pins.blurb: A roadside Hilo waterfall. Morning brings the rainbows.

pins.name: Hanakapiai Beach and Falls (Kalalau Trail, Haena State Park)
pins.blurb: The Na Pali cliffs on foot, to a beach or on to a jungle waterfall.

pins.name: Wailua River kayak (Secret Falls)
pins.blurb: Paddle up a jungle river.

pins.name: Kiholo Bay (Wainanalii lagoon)
pins.blurb: A calm lava-framed lagoon with sea turtles.

pins.name: Kaneohe Bay sandbar (Ahu o Laka)
pins.blurb: Shallow turquoise water in the middle of the bay, under the Koolau cliffs.

pins.name: Lanikai and Kailua beaches, plus Kaiwa Ridge (Lanikai Pillbox) hike
pins.blurb: Calm windward water and the Mokulua islets.

pins.name: Makena State Park (Oneloa / Big Beach)
pins.blurb: A wide, wild golden beach.

pins.name: Waianapanapa State Park
pins.blurb: Black sand, sea caves and a lava-coast trail on the Road to Hana.

pins.name: Hanalei Bay
pins.blurb: Kauaʻi's north-shore bay, with waterfalls on the mountains behind it.

pins.name: Tunnels (Makua) and Haena Beach Park
pins.blurb: Reef snorkeling under the Na Pali mountains.

pins.name: Papakolea Green Sand Beach
pins.blurb: The green-sand beach at the south tip, a long walk from anywhere.

pins.name: Kaena Point (Natural Area Reserve)
pins.blurb: Oʻahu's remote western tip, with seabirds and monk seals.

pins.name: Makapuu Lighthouse Trail (Kaiwi State Scenic Shoreline)
pins.blurb: A paved coastal climb with winter whales and a view to Molokai.

pins.name: Waipio Valley Lookout
pins.blurb: The rim view into Waipio's cliff-walled valley.

pins.name: Waimea Canyon Lookout
pins.blurb: Kauaʻi's canyon from its one open lookout.

pins.name: Hau Tree, Kaimana Beach
pins.blurb: Four courses on the sand at Kaimana Beach, from 4 p.m. on both nights. The quiet end of Waikiki.

pins.name: Hy's Steak House
pins.blurb: A dark-wood steakhouse with a set Christmas dinner every night from Dec 21 to Jan 1, so it fits any trip that touches Oʻahu.

pins.name: Stripsteak
pins.blurb: Michael Mina's steakhouse at International Market Place, a short walk from Donn Beach's banyan. The set menu runs both nights.

pins.name: 53 By The Sea
pins.blurb: A waterfront dining room in Kakaʻako with one set menu on both nights.

pins.name: Beachhouse at the Moana
pins.blurb: Holiday dinner menus on both nights at the Moana Surfrider, with Santa coming in by outrigger canoe on Christmas Eve.

pins.name: Tiki's Grill & Bar
pins.blurb: The tiki bar with the Waikiki ocean view runs a Christmas surf and turf from 4 p.m. on both days. The Christmas Bar pop-up is in the same building.

pins.name: Four Seasons Ko Olina
pins.blurb: Ko Olina's Christmas Eve buffet and Christmas brunch, 45 minutes to an hour from Waikiki. There's an 18-and-over pool.

pins.name: La Mer, Halekulani
pins.blurb: Halekulani's French room has run Christmas menus before. Nothing is posted for this year, so this one takes a phone call.

pins.name: Orchids, Halekulani
pins.blurb: Brunch and dinner buffets at Halekulani on both days. In 2024 that meant oysters, snow crab, lobster tail and a carving station. The best Christmas table in Waikiki, and the first to fill.

pins.name: House Without A Key, Christmas Day
pins.blurb: Four courses under the kiawe tree at Halekulani on Christmas Day.

pins.name: Azure, Royal Hawaiian
pins.blurb: A Christmas Day tasting menu on the beach at the Pink Palace.

pins.name: Roy's Waikiki
pins.blurb: Roy Yamaguchi's room on the Waikiki Beach Walk, with a Christmas Day menu priced by the entrée.

pins.name: Merriman's Honolulu
pins.blurb: Farm-to-table in Kakaʻako, with a Christmas Day prix fixe.

pins.name: Plumeria Beach House, Kahala
pins.blurb: A beachfront buffet at the Kahala, past Diamond Head. Lunch on Christmas Eve, and the full spread on Christmas Day.

pins.name: 100 Sails, Prince Waikiki
pins.blurb: Buffets over the yacht harbor: Christmas dinner from Dec 24 to 28, and a brunch on Christmas Day.

pins.name: Ala Moana Center
pins.blurb: Ala Moana and the other big malls close on Christmas Day.

pins.name: Diamond Head
pins.blurb: Diamond Head closes on Christmas Day.

pins.name: Pearl Harbor visitor center
pins.blurb: The Pearl Harbor visitor center closes on Christmas Day.

pins.name: Polynesian Cultural Center
pins.blurb: The Polynesian Cultural Center closes on Christmas Day.

pins.name: The Christmas Bar at Tiki's
pins.blurb: A Christmas bar pop-up inside Tiki's, back every year. Last year it ran until Dec 30.

pins.name: Prince Waikiki holiday bar
pins.blurb: The Prince's holiday bar, home to Sippin' Santa, the tiki Christmas pop-up, in past years.

pins.name: MAKANA at the ʻAlohilani
pins.blurb: A 21-and-over holiday pop-up in the Oceanarium Lounge at the ʻAlohilani. Last year it was open on Christmas Eve and Christmas night.

pins.name: Honolulu City Lights
pins.blurb: The big tree and Shaka Santa at Honolulu Hale, free, from Dec 5. Last year it ran through Dec 31.

pins.name: Christmas Eve at Halekulani
pins.blurb: Halekulani's Christmas Eve: Santa arrives at 3:30 and a holiday reception runs on the Hau Terrace from 5 to 6.

pins.name: Kawaiahaʻo Church
pins.blurb: The coral-block church from 1842, across the street from the City Lights. This year's Christmas Eve service time isn't posted.

pins.name: Hotel Wailea
pins.blurb: Five courses above the sea at the adults-only hotel, on both nights. The most grown-up Christmas dinner on any island.

pins.name: Spago and Ferraro's, Four Seasons Maui
pins.blurb: Spago and Ferraro's add Christmas specials to the regular menus in Wailea.

pins.name: Cane & Canoe, Montage Kapalua
pins.blurb: Kapalua's oceanfront room serves Christmas dinners on both nights.

pins.name: Merriman's Kapalua
pins.blurb: Merriman's on the Kapalua point, with a Christmas prix fixe. A half lobster is $40 more.

pins.name: Ritz-Carlton Kapalua
pins.blurb: Christmas Day dinners at the Ritz-Carlton up in Kapalua.

pins.name: Haleakala
pins.blurb: Haleakala on Christmas Day. The park's hours page shows no closure, but that's worth a call.

pins.name: Drums of the Pacific, Hyatt Maui
pins.blurb: Drums of the Pacific, the Hyatt Regency's luau in Kaanapali, takes bookings for Christmas Day. Over Christmas the resort leans family.

pins.name: CanoeHouse, Mauna Lani
pins.blurb: A family-style tasting at Mauna Lani: scallop crudo, lobster and braised wagyu short rib. Resort guests only, Dec 18 to Jan 3.

pins.name: Kona Village
pins.blurb: Christmas Eve and Christmas dinners at Kona Village. Ask the concierge whether non-guests can book.

pins.name: Brown's Beach House
pins.blurb: Brown's Beach House at the Fairmont Orchid, with a holiday dinner on the sand.

pins.name: Mauna Kea Beach Hotel
pins.address: 62-100 Mauna Kea Beach Drive, Kohala Coast
pins.blurb: The Mauna Kea Beach Hotel's Christmas Eve and Christmas Day menus.

pins.name: PIKO, Outrigger Kona
pins.blurb: A big Christmas Eve buffet on Keauhou Bay, the easy choice from Kona.

pins.name: Huggo's
pins.blurb: Three courses on the rocks in Kailua village, from 3 p.m., and the best Christmas Day deal in Kona. Last year you booked by text.

pins.name: Honu's on the Beach
pins.blurb: A Christmas brunch buffet on the beach in Kailua-Kona.

pins.name: HaLani, Mauna Lani
pins.blurb: Christmas dinner at Mauna Lani. Resort guests only, Dec 18 to Jan 3.

pins.name: Beach Tree, Four Seasons Hualalai
pins.blurb: A Christmas Day buffet at the Four Seasons Hualalai.

pins.name: Merriman's Waimea
pins.blurb: Merriman's Waimea serves its holiday menu every day except Dec 24 and 25.

pins.name: Hawaii Volcanoes National Park
pins.blurb: Hawaii Volcanoes National Park stays open on Christmas Day.

pins.name: 1 Hotel Hanalei Bay
pins.blurb: Christmas Eve dinner and a Christmas Day buffet in Princeville, looking out on Hanalei Bay.

pins.name: Gaylord's at Kilohana
pins.blurb: Christmas dinner at a 1930s plantation estate outside Lihue, noon to 8 p.m., ordered off the menu.

pins.name: Grand Hyatt Kauaʻi
pins.blurb: Christmas at the Grand Hyatt in Poipu, plus a Christmas meal to go.

pins.name: Red Salt, Koa Kea
pins.blurb: A Christmas Day prix fixe at Red Salt in Poipu.

pins.name: Brennecke's Beach Broiler
pins.blurb: Casual beachfront seafood in Poipu, open both days in 2023.

pins.name: Kauaʻi Festival of Lights
pins.blurb: Lihue's Festival of Lights at the Historic County Building. Last year it ran Dec 1 to 29.
